name: riposte
description: Deterministic re-checks of figures and quotations already read from business documents, and of AI agents' decisions: PASS, FAIL or can't tell, each with a proof you can replay offline. Verdicts are unsigned by default; the hash-chained receipt ledger is signed when you give it a key.
author: E. Tucker Anderson

scripts.build: npm run build -w riposte-verify && npm run build -w riposte-ai && npm run build -w riposte-adapters
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w riposte-verify && npm run typecheck -w riposte-ai && npm run typecheck -w riposte-adapters
